Name: No Built In Kitchen
Author: Roxana11037
Description:
[font=Arial][size=3][b]🌟﻿﻿This is a updated version of "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12120][i]No Built In Kitchen[/i][/url]﻿[/b][b]" that is orginally uploaded by [/b][i][u]Asterisk555[/u][/i][b].🌟
[/b][/size][/font]
Due to changes in Stardew Valley 1.6, the original creator of this mod have hidden it. I discovered this on ModDrop﻿ and instantly fell in love with it. Unfortunately, in version 1.6, it no longer works for upgrade 2 and 3 farmhouses.

[font=Arial]As an crazy brewer obsessed with filling cabins with kegs (cabins are too cheap), I just couldn't let this mod go.😭😭😭[/font][font=Arial]So, I spent a week learning how to make mods and updated it to fully support version 1.6. [/font][font=Arial]This update is primarily for personal use, but I decided to upload it for those who wanna fill their upgraded cabins with kegs (like me).
[/font][font=Arial]
[/font][font=Arial]I’m also a big fan of[i][url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1153510-dga-asters-buildable-kitchen]Asters Buildable Kitchen for DGA[/url]﻿﻿,[/i] but DGA is no longer compatible with version 1.6. I’m currently learning how to migrate the mod to use Content Patcher (CP).[/font][font=Arial][b][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33316]Kissa's Buildable Kitchen[/url]﻿[/i] [/b]has the similar function, by combining that mod with mine, you’ll be able to build your ideal kitchen anywhere inside the farmhouse[b].


[/b][/font][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

[font=Arial]The mod only modifies the square where the original kitchen is, so it should be compatible with any customized farmhouse layout that doesn't affect the original kitchen area.
[/font][font=Arial][b]
[/b][/font][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]﻿

[font=Arial]As I told above, I am entirely rookie for modding. Although I and my friends have tested this mod, here might still be a few bugs.(sry..) [/font][font=Arial]If you find any issues, I might not be able to fix them right away, but I’d love to discuss them with you. If you have any suggestions to improve the mod, please feel free to share them!

[/font][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]
﻿[font=Arial][size=3][b][center]Asterisk555----Original author (Thanks for your amazing works🌹🌹)[/center][/b][/size][/font][font=Arial][b]
[/b][/font][center][b][size=3][font=Arial]If the original author updates and re-uploads this mod on Nexus. Please let me know—I’ll take this version down immediately. Also, if the original creator feels uncomfortable with my update, I sincerely apologize. Please feel free to contact me, and I’ll remove it right away.[/font]
[/size][/b][/center]
